title: Implement bank statement reconciliation
goal: Implement shop.ledger.reconcile exactly as specified in its docstring.
acceptance_criteria: a statement line and a ledger entry may match only if their amounts are equal as Decimals (strings, ints and Decimals compare by value) and their dates differ by at most max_days
matching is one-to-one and greedy over statement lines ordered by (date, id)

among the candidates, an entry whose ref (case-insensitive, non-empty) occurs in the line's memo wins; otherwise the smallest date difference; remaining ties go to the smallest ledger id (string order)
returns {'matched': [(statement_id, ledger_id), ...] sorted by statement id, 'unmatched_statement': [ids sorted], 'unmatched_ledger': [ids sorted]} (string order)
